title: The Isthmus of Panama and the Darién: a jungle without a road
goal: Describe the isthmus and the Darién jungle with relative clauses (que, quien).
grammar: relative clauses with que and quien

sections.title: The Isthmus of Panama and the Darién: a jungle without a road
body: In this lesson you read about the narrow strip of land between two seas and about the Darién, the jungle where the Pan-American Highway stops. You will also read what the Panamanian authorities said about migrants who cross it.
The grammar is one you know: relative clauses with *que* and *quien*. The screens and instructions are in English; the readings are in Spanish.

items: I can describe the isthmus and the Darién with relative clauses (*que*, *quien*).
I can say what the Darién is and why it matters.
I can use the new words for the isthmus, swamps and eagles.
